recommendations: Prioritize inspection and calibration of M2, which shows a scrap rate of 14.47% compared with the overall average of 7.16%.
Monitor machine vibration more closely, as vibration is one of the strongest drivers of predicted scrap risk and may indicate tool wear or unstable machine condition.
Investigate cycle time deviations above 50 seconds, as longer cycle times may indicate process instability or machine-related delays.
Review process temperature control, especially for runs above 190°C, where scrap risk increases.
Use additional process guidance or checklists for less experienced operators to reduce quality variation.
Use this dashboard as an early warning tool, but validate all findings with real production data before making operational changes.

summary.note: Rules are loaded from configuration files and used for decision support.

spec_requirements.label: Temperature warning
spec_requirements.description: Process temperature should remain within the normal operating window.
spec_requirements.rationale: Elevated temperature may indicate thermal drift or insufficient cooling control.
spec_requirements.recommended_action: Review temperature control and cooling stability for affected records.

spec_requirements.label: Temperature critical
spec_requirements.description: Process temperature should not exceed the critical monitoring limit.
spec_requirements.rationale: Very high temperature may increase scrap risk or indicate process instability.
spec_requirements.recommended_action: Escalate for engineering review and check thermal process settings.

spec_requirements.label: Vibration warning
spec_requirements.description: Vibration should remain within the normal monitoring band.
spec_requirements.rationale: Elevated vibration may indicate early tool wear, fixture instability, or imbalance.
spec_requirements.recommended_action: Trend vibration and inspect tooling if the signal persists.

spec_requirements.label: Vibration critical
spec_requirements.description: Vibration should not exceed the critical inspection threshold.
spec_requirements.rationale: High vibration may indicate mechanical instability or maintenance issues.
spec_requirements.recommended_action: Perform engineering review of machine condition, tooling, and fixture stability.

spec_requirements.label: Cycle-time warning
spec_requirements.description: Cycle time should remain within the expected process window.
spec_requirements.rationale: Long cycle time may indicate setup drift, handling delay, or process instability.
spec_requirements.recommended_action: Compare against setup records and operator notes.

spec_requirements.label: Cycle-time critical
spec_requirements.description: Cycle time should not materially exceed the critical monitoring limit.
spec_requirements.rationale: Abnormal cycle time may indicate machine wear, unstable settings, or material handling problems.
spec_requirements.recommended_action: Investigate machine condition and recent setup changes.

spec_requirements.label: Low pressure warning
spec_requirements.description: Process pressure should not fall below the lower monitoring band.
spec_requirements.rationale: Low pressure may indicate leakage, feed variation, or insufficient process force.
spec_requirements.recommended_action: Check pressure regulation, fixture condition, and feed stability.

spec_requirements.label: High pressure warning
spec_requirements.description: Process pressure should not exceed the upper monitoring band.
spec_requirements.rationale: High pressure may indicate restriction, blocked flow path, or aggressive process settings.
spec_requirements.recommended_action: Inspect pressure regulation and tooling restrictions.

spec_requirements.label: Humidity warning
spec_requirements.description: Humidity should remain within the configured environmental monitoring band.
spec_requirements.rationale: High humidity may affect material behavior, handling, or surface quality.
spec_requirements.recommended_action: Check humidity controls and material storage conditions.

spec_requirements.label: Operator support warning
spec_requirements.description: Low-experience operation should receive additional process guidance.
spec_requirements.rationale: Less experienced operators may need checklist support during unstable process conditions.
spec_requirements.recommended_action: Use operator guidance, checklist support, or supervisor review.

rca_rules.label: Very high temperature
rca_rules.possible_cause: Potential thermal drift, overheating, resin degradation, or process setpoint issue.
rca_rules.evidence: temperature is well above the configured risk threshold
rca_rules.recommended_action: Audit temperature setpoints, cooling performance, and recent thermal alarms before further review action.

rca_rules.label: High temperature
rca_rules.possible_cause: Possible thermal process drift or insufficient cooling control.
rca_rules.evidence: temperature is above the configured risk threshold
rca_rules.recommended_action: Review process temperature control and verify cooling stability around the affected batch.

rca_rules.label: Low temperature
rca_rules.possible_cause: Possible under-heating, poor material flow, or incomplete process stabilization.
rca_rules.evidence: temperature is below the expected operating range
rca_rules.recommended_action: Check heating stability, warm-up completion, and material flow conditions.

rca_rules.label: High pressure
rca_rules.possible_cause: Possible restriction, blocked flow path, fixture issue, or aggressive process setting.
rca_rules.evidence: pressure is above the expected operating range
rca_rules.recommended_action: Inspect pressure regulation, tooling restrictions, and fixture condition.

rca_rules.label: Low pressure
rca_rules.possible_cause: Possible leakage, poor clamping, feed variation, or insufficient process force.
rca_rules.evidence: pressure is below the expected operating range
rca_rules.recommended_action: Check for leaks, feed variation, clamp issues, or insufficient process force.

rca_rules.label: High vibration
rca_rules.possible_cause: Possible mechanical instability, tool wear, imbalance, or maintenance issue.
rca_rules.evidence: vibration is above the configured risk threshold
rca_rules.recommended_action: Inspect machine vibration sources and check for tool wear, imbalance, or loose fixtures.

rca_rules.label: Elevated vibration
rca_rules.possible_cause: Potential early signal of tool wear, loose fixtures, or machine imbalance.
rca_rules.evidence: vibration is above the normal monitoring band
rca_rules.recommended_action: Trend vibration for the machine and inspect tooling if the signal persists.

rca_rules.label: Abnormal cycle time
rca_rules.possible_cause: Possible process slowdown, material handling delay, machine wear, or unstable settings.
rca_rules.evidence: cycle time is materially above the configured risk threshold
rca_rules.recommended_action: Investigate cycle time deviation, material handling delays, and machine wear indicators.

rca_rules.label: Long cycle time
rca_rules.possible_cause: Possible setup drift, slower material flow, or operator intervention during the batch.
rca_rules.evidence: cycle time is above the configured risk threshold
rca_rules.recommended_action: Review cycle time drift and compare against recent setup or operator changes.

rca_rules.label: Low operator experience
rca_rules.possible_cause: Additional checklist support or supervisor review may reduce setup and handling variation.
rca_rules.recommended_action: Use operator guidance, checklist support, or supervisor sign-off for this setup.

rca_rules.label: High humidity
rca_rules.possible_cause: Possible environmental contribution to material behavior, handling, or surface quality.
rca_rules.evidence: humidity is above the configured monitoring band
rca_rules.recommended_action: Check humidity controls and confirm material storage conditions.

rca_rules.label: Machine M2 risk pattern
rca_rules.possible_cause: This asset may need calibration review, maintenance inspection, or process capability checks.
rca_rules.evidence: machine is M2, which is configured as a higher-risk asset
rca_rules.recommended_action: Inspect M2 calibration, maintenance status, and recent quality history.

rca_rules.label: Machine M4 risk pattern
rca_rules.possible_cause: Monitor for recurring variation before scheduling deeper engineering action.
rca_rules.evidence: machine is M4, which carries a mild configured risk signal
rca_rules.recommended_action: Monitor M4 quality trend and confirm process settings remain within control limits.

rca_rules.label: Night shift production
rca_rules.possible_cause: Higher scrap risk may reflect staffing, handoff, environmental, or monitoring differences.
rca_rules.evidence: batch was produced during night shift
rca_rules.recommended_action: Apply additional process checks during night shift production.

rca_rules.label: Late shift production
rca_rules.possible_cause: Consider checking shift handoff notes and process adherence if this pattern repeats.
rca_rules.evidence: batch was produced during late shift
rca_rules.recommended_action: Review shift handoff notes and confirm standard work adherence.

rca_rules.label: Material batch B4
rca_rules.condition: matches B4, batch B4, material B4
rca_rules.possible_cause: Possible incoming material variation, storage condition issue, or supplier lot effect.
rca_rules.evidence: material batch is B4, which is configured as a higher-risk batch
rca_rules.recommended_action: Quarantine or sample-check material batch B4 and compare against supplier lot history.
